harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 to run inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 and append output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Verified persistence through a node restart without changing CentOS 5.11 or kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.
actions_performed: Installed a root-owned Vixie Cron entry in /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance.
Configured stdout and stderr to append to the requested log.
Verified real output capture before and after restart.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Confirmed crond, the schedule, and retained log recovered after restart.

evidence.requirement: Daily execution at 02:15 with retained output
evidence.summary: Shows the exact `15 2 * * *` schedule, append redirection, correct ownership/SELinux context, running crond, and successful log entries before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Pre-change, pre-restart, and post-restart checks consistently report CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 64944ad8-82ab-470b-8000-000000000000; reboot was acknowledged, SSH became unavailable during restart, and the recovered node reported changed boot ID 15502a6d-88af-4d31-8000-000000000000 with crond running, schedule intact, and retained log data verified.
